title: Symmetry breaking of single-atom catalysts in heterogeneous electrocatalysis: reactivity and configuration
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00209E, Tutorial Review
Bin Wu, Zuohuan Chen, Yifan Ye, Justin Zhu Yeow Seow, Daniel Mandler, Adrian Fisher, Dingsheng Wang, Shaojun Guo, Zhichuan J. Xu
Atomic-scale symmetry breaking in single-atom catalysts redistributes electron density to tune reaction energetics, enhancing electrocatalytic performance by improving intermediate adsorption and lowering activation barriers.
